Sen Kaibara.name: Sen Kaibara
Sen Kaibara.basicInfo:
Sen Kaibara, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, already his new classmates' dry voice of the obvious. Shaggy dark-brown hair, narrow dark eyes, slightly tanned skin, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or a white spiral-tubed hero windbreaker.
Speaking Style: Plain and dry: short corrections, a flat one-liner when 1-B gets carried away, said once.
Combat Role: Close-range bruiser: Gyrate spins a fist or forearm to bore through a guard or turn a blow, only at arm's reach.
Under Pressure: Gets terse, takes the nearest useful job and cuts grandstanders short.
Sen Kaibara.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He keeps 1-B's theatrics in proportion, yet his own patience runs out first. Motivation: A working hero's career on a simple Quirk used well, and a 1-B taken seriously. Concealment: His face shows the irritation his deadpan hides. Leverage: Practical arguments; a classmate in real trouble. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, whose lead 1-B already follows; Neito Monoma, whose speeches against 1-A get a flat look; Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, easier to fight beside than to talk down; Vlad King, the homeroom teacher, loud in 1-B's corner. Knowledge: Knows 1-A only from campus talk. Canon voice & behavior: Names the real problem in one sentence, then starts the task. Thread: Whether a steady, unflashy fighter gets noticed in a year full of showmen.
QUIRK: Gyrate. Spins any part of his own body at high speed, enough to bore into a guard or turn a blow aside. Contact range only; no barrier, no ranged force, and a spinning limb can still be caught, cut or hurt.
personality: Straight man: Answers 1-B's louder antics with a flat look and a one-line reality check.
Levelheaded: Picks the plan that works over the one that looks good.
Unshowy: Takes the close-range job in a group plan and asks for no credit.
Speaking style: Plain, grounded remarks and short corrections; dry, never a speech.
abilities: Drilling strike: A spinning close-range blow that bores through a guard or breaks a hold; he stops it short of piercing.
Spin deflection: Spins a forearm to turn aside a manageable blow; heavy, piercing or ranged attacks get through.
Closing in: Footwork gets him inside an opponent's reach; at a distance Gyrate does nothing.
Reality check: Cuts a team argument down to the point that matters; louder classmates may not listen.
Fighting style: Closes plainly, spins the opening attack aside, then ends it with one drilling strike.
Sen Kaibara.visualDescription: A young man with shaggy dark-brown hair, narrow dark eyes, slightly tanned skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Level, unimpressed expression with a faint, dry half-smile.
